claim: Combines operator training with PINN-style physics residual constraints without adopting single-instance PINN inference.
claim_zh: 将方程残差监督融入神经算子训练，而非仅针对单个问题求解。
innovation_detail: Add equation-residual supervision to neural-operator learning rather than solve only one instance.
innovation_detail_zh: 将方程残差监督融入神经算子训练，而非仅针对单个问题求解。
bottleneck: Data-only operator learning can lack physical consistency or require many labeled solves.
bottleneck_zh: 纯数据算子学习可能物理一致性不足，且依赖大量标注解场。
tradeoff: Adding residual penalties does not prove physical validity outside the training regime.
